instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Record that an account typed a referral code it was given, and give back the events to save", and give it account (The account that typed the code); code; events (The referral events saved so far (a code made or withdrawn, a code typed, a signup)).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:apply-a-referral-code and its input (the worked example shows one).
